model.reasoning: The guideline specifies that Acceptable construction type requires ">50% JM, non-combustible/steel, or masonry non-combustible". The submission has exactly 50% of TIV in acceptable construction types, which fails to meet the >50% threshold and is therefore Not Acceptable. Under Rule 1, "If any factor is Not Acceptable, the verdict is DOES_NOT_FIT", with construction_type being the first Not Acceptable factor.
